nodes.description: uint64 public percentage of balance routed to the benefactor address on withdrawal.
uint64 counter of tokens currently minted, incremented in mint loops and special mints.
uint64 public mint price per token (0.02 ether), settable by owner.
uint64 public token supply limit used to seed RandomlyAssigned.
bool public pause flag gating public minting.
bool public toggle enabling the benefactor payout branch in withdraw.
address public recipient of the benefactor share of withdrawn funds.
string public base URI prefix used by _baseURI and tokenURI.
string public URI suffix appended in tokenURI.
public payable mint entry point; enforces compliance, pause flag and msg.value >= cost * amount, then calls _mintLoop(msg.sender, amount).
onlyOwner special mint of reserved IDs above supply, increments currentSupply and calls _safeMint.
onlyOwner mint that calls _mintLoop for an arbitrary receiver.
view helper iterating token IDs to collect all tokens owned by a given address.
view override building the token metadata URI from _baseURI, token id and uriSuffix.
onlyOwner setter updating the mint cost.
onlyOwner setter updating benefactor address and benefactor percentage.
onlyOwner setter toggling the benefactor payout branch.
onlyOwner setter updating uriPrefix.
onlyOwner setter updating uriSuffix.
onlyOwner setter toggling the paused flag.
onlyOwner fund withdrawal using two low-level calls (benefactor share then owner remainder) with state read after the external call.
internal loop that fetches nextToken, increments currentSupply and calls _safeMint for each requested token.
Caller-controlled address used as mint receiver and for owner authorization checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp fed into the pseudo-random token id generation.
Low-level call{value: balance * benefactorPercentage / 100} to the benefactor address inside withdraw, executed before the owner payout.
Low-level call{value: address(this).balance} to owner() inside withdraw, using the post-benefactor balance.
Caller-supplied mint quantity used by mint and mintForAddress compliance and loop.
Address receiving minted tokens in mintForAddress/mintSpecialForAddress paths.
Special token ID argument validated by specialCompliance in mintSpecialForAddress.
Address queried by walletOfOwner for owned token enumeration.
Token ID argument used by tokenURI to build metadata URI.
Loop index variable inside _mintLoop.
Local token id returned by nextToken inside _mintLoop and passed to _safeMint.
New mint price supplied to setCost by the owner.
New benefactor address supplied to setBenefactor by the owner.
New benefactor percentage supplied to setBenefactor by the owner.
New base URI prefix supplied to setUriPrefix by the owner.
New URI suffix supplied to setUriSuffix by the owner.
New boolean pause state supplied to setPaused by the owner.
Inherited RandomlyAssigned.nextToken that derives a pseudo-random id from msg.sender, coinbase, difficulty, gaslimit and block.timestamp.
_safeMint to the receiver triggers the IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received external callback before state is fully finalized.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the receiver into the mint entry point.
msg.sender flows as _receiver into _mintLoop from mint.
_mintAmount parameter drives mintCompliance and the mint loop call.
_mintAmount bounds the _mintLoop iteration count.
_receiver is forwarded into _mintLoop for token delivery.
_mintAmount parameter drives mintForAddress compliance and loop.
_receiver parameter is used by mintForAddress to route tokens.
_id parameter is checked by specialCompliance and used in _safeMint.
_owner parameter selects which balances/owned tokens are enumerated.
_tokenId parameter is concatenated into the returned metadata URI.
_cost parameter overwrites the cost state variable.
_address parameter overwrites the benefactor state variable.
percentage parameter overwrites benefactorPercentage.
_uriPrefix parameter overwrites the uriPrefix state variable.
_uriSuffix parameter overwrites the uriSuffix state variable.
_state parameter overwrites the paused flag.
block.timestamp is hashed into the pseudo-random token id selection, making minting outcome miner-influenceable.
Loop index i controls _mintLoop iteration.
Local id from nextToken is minted inside _mintLoop.
withdraw performs the benefactor low-level value call before the owner payout settles the balance.
withdraw performs a second low-level value call to owner() using the live contract balance.
_mintLoop invokes nextToken to obtain each token id.
mint delegates token creation to _mintLoop.
mintForAddress delegates token creation to _mintLoop.
_mintLoop reaches _safeMint which calls back into the receiver contract via onERC721Received.
The benefactor low-level call can re-enter withdraw before the owner payout completes.
The owner low-level call can re-enter withdraw since no reentrancy guard exists.
mintSpecialForAddress reaches _safeMint which invokes the receiver onERC721Received callback.
msg.sender is compared against owner() through the onlyOwner guard protecting withdraw.

normalization_plan.reason: _mintAmount is a transient mint quantity parameter consumed directly by the mint function.
_receiver is a transient receiver parameter consumed by the _mintLoop/minter operation.
_id is a transient special token id parameter consumed by mintSpecialForAddress.
_owner is a transient query parameter consumed by walletOfOwner.
_tokenId is a transient query parameter consumed by tokenURI.
Loop index i is a local variable scoped to the _mintLoop function.
Local id is a temporary token identifier scoped to the _mintLoop function.
_cost is a transient setter parameter consumed by setCost.
_address is a transient setter parameter consumed by setBenefactor.
percentage is a transient setter parameter consumed by setBenefactor.
_uriPrefix is a transient setter parameter consumed by setUriPrefix.
_uriSuffix is a transient setter parameter consumed by setUriSuffix.
_state is a transient setter parameter consumed by setPaused.
